title: Systematic Multiscale Design of Hierarchical Materials
exact_target: Find a systematic theory for designing material structure across many scales to achieve specified mechanical properties.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30000191 (OWR-790-001). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mini-Workshop: Mathematical Methods and Models of Continuum Biomechanics (2005), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2005/09, pp. 503--528; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF page 6, printed page 508.
Gao et al., materials become insensitive to flaws at nanoscale; reference in the saved dated catalogue literature review.

status_qualification: This is a four-part design research program. The source does not specify a universal class of admissible microstructures, a property map, an optimization norm, or an algorithmic complexity target. These must be chosen for any subsequent precise model; adding them here would invent a narrower problem.
